population: 771 occupations with at least20 known mean ratings;35 numeric or null dimensions
sourceMetric: Mean absolute importance difference divided by4 over at least20 jointly rated skills; unsupported pairs absent in CSR, supported zeros and diagonal explicit; no imputation
recall: For kth source distance t, L={d<t-tolerance}, T={abs(d-t)<=tolerance}, q=k-|L|. E is Euclidean displayed top-k, ties canonical code. R=(|E intersect L|+min(q,|E intersect T|))/k. Mean all rows at k=5,10,20; S is mean of these three recalls.
display: Normalize and round raw coordinates8 decimals then exact runtime TS spaceOccupationMap without further rounding. Baseline full historical772 spacing then restrict771 without respacing.
qualification: All three seeds successful; mean S >= historical displayed baseline S +0.02; mean recall >= baseline at each k; every seed S > baseline S.
selection: Highest qualifying mean S, then highest minimum seed S, then prescribed grid order. Ship seed11. If no configuration qualifies halt promotion; no fallback or tuning.
stability: Supplementary exact numeric/null-profile identity overlap among displayed top-k, all within-configuration seed pairs.
diagnostics: Unsupported pair count, minimum supported neighbors, distinct profiles and singleton/repeated recall groups; raw recall supplementary.
reproduction: One selected seed-11 confirmation rerun, outside selection; save and compare rounded coordinates exactly.
limits: In-sample descriptive metric, not external occupational ground truth. Duplicate profiles may separate algorithmically. Global axes and distances are not interpretable. Do not select using appearance. No extra grid phase.
